data.title: How will Saudi Arabia respond to Iran-backed Houthis' airport attacks? | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Similar to how Iran targeted US bases in the region, Iran’s allies in Yemen are seeking to disrupt civilian life in Saudi Arabia by getting airports closed and flights canceled.
